# Cached contribs (CI-generated — do not edit by hand)

This directory holds the **full VLC contrib dependency closure**, built from
source inside the GitHub Actions runner images by `contribs-vlc<N>-cached.yml`
and committed here so the libvlc build (`build-vlc<N>-cached.yml`) can restore
it without rebuilding.

Layout, per VLC series and runtime ID:

```
vlc-3.0/<rid>/
  MANIFEST              # rid, triplet, sha256, origin build_prefix, part count, ...
  contrib.tar.zst.aaa  # split parts (<100 MB each) of the zstd-compressed
  contrib.tar.zst.aab  # contrib/<triplet> prefix
  ...
```

The archives are split into <100 MB parts because GitHub rejects individual
files larger than 100 MiB. Reassemble + inspect locally with:

```sh
cd vlc-3.0/<rid>
cat contrib.tar.zst.* | zstd -d | tar -tvf -
```

These files are regenerated by CI; do not edit them manually. To refresh a
target, re-run the `contribs-*` workflow for it.
